verdict.rationale: Pandoc's manual documents a standalone CLI where one line converts a file (e.g. `pandoc test.txt -o test.pdf`), with format inference from extensions and stdin/stdout support for piping in scripts. It also documents running in GitHub Actions and via a Docker image. Community reports confirm scripted automation pipelines built on it. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage (the CI docs only point to example workflows).

support.subject: As a developer, a documented command converts a file in one line, usable from scripts and CI

citations.quote: To produce a PDF, specify an output file with a .pdf extension: pandoc test.txt -o test.pdf
If no input-files are specified, input is read from stdin. Output goes to stdout by default.
Pandoc can be run through GitHub Actions.
scripts wrote model inputs as Markdown tables embedded in a Markdown writeup, and Pandoc produced the Word report for sponsors
